customManagers.description: Track the zlib release stevedore builds its deflate from.
The clang22 release stevedore is built with: its Linux archive on Linux, verified against components/clang22/sha256, and its clang22-cross pkg on a Mac that has not installed that release.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/clang22/version but cannot vouch for the new Linux archive, so the Linux builds fail at the fetch until components/clang22/sha256 is written for it.
prBodyNotes: The Linux builds fail until components/clang22/sha256 is the new release's linux-x86_64 archive digest. .github/workflows/pins-bot.yml writes it on this branch with `sh build/pin-clang22.sh fill`; if that bot failed, run `sh build/pin-clang22.sh` on this branch (it checks the archive against the release's SHA256SUMS) and commit the file.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/zlib/version but cannot vouch for the new tarball, so the build fails at the fetch until components/zlib/sha256 is written for it.
prBodyNotes: The build fails until components/zlib/sha256 matches the new tarball. .github/workflows/pins-bot.yml writes it on this branch; if that bot failed, run `sh build/pin-zlib.sh` on this branch (it checks GitHub's tarball against zlib.net's). Regenerate tests/fixtures/gz with `sh tests/fixtures/gz/generate.sh` if the deflate output moved, and commit both.
